basic_details.job_title: DHS Tirunelveli Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for Account Assistant, Clinical Psychologist and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Account Assistant, Clinical Psychologist, Psychiatric Staff Nurse
basic_details.short_information: District Health Society Tirunelveli (DHS Tirunelveli) Recruitment 2026 notification has been released by District Health Society Tirunelveli (DHS Tirunelveli) on its official website for the recruitment of 3 Account Assistant, Clinical Psychologist, and Psychiatric Staff Nurse posts under Advertisement No. 05/2026. This recruitment offers an excellent opportunity for eligible candidates seeking contract-based government jobs in the healthcare sector.

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 35 years for all posts.

qualification.education_qualification: B.Com Degree With Tally and Two Years Experience, M.Sc Psychology, M.Phil, Nursing Qualification with Specialized training of Six months
qualification.details: Account Assistant: B.Com Degree with Tally and Two Years Experience. Clinical Psychologist: M.Sc Psychology, M.Phil. Psychiatric Staff Nurse: Nursing Qualification adopted in Government Medical institutions with Specialized training of Six months in identified institutions preferred.

salary_details.details: Account Assistant: Rs.19,000/- Clinical Psychologist: Rs.23,800/- Psychiatric Staff Nurse: Rs.18,000/-

how_to_apply: Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://tirunelvelinic.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 08-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://tirunelvelinic.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 08-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DHS Tirunelveli Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the District Health Society Tirunelveli recruitment is 08 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in DHS Tirunelveli Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced by the District Health Society Tirunelveli for the posts of Account Assistant, Clinical Psychologist, and Psychiatric Staff Nurse.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the DHS Tirunelveli Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts under this recruitment is 35 years. Age relaxation details, if any, will be mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Account Assistant post?
faq.answer: For the Account Assistant post, candidates must possess a B.Com Degree with Tally and have at least two years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Clinical Psychologist post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Clinical Psychologist post will receive a salary of Rs. 23,800/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for DHS Tirunelveli Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the DHS Tirunelveli Recruitment 2026 typically involves an interview for some posts and document verification for all shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the District Health Society Tirunelveli, which is https://tirunelvelinic.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for the positions announced by the District Health Society Tirunelveli is contract-based.
